slides.texte_overlay:
5 Things that quietly
destroy your confidence

1. Breaking small promises
to yourself
Every skipped alarm
teaches you that you
can't trust yourself.

2. Apologizing for everything
Sorry for asking. Sorry for
existing. Save it for real mistakes.

3. Never finishing
what you start
Half-done projects pile up
like quiet proof against you.

4. Hiding your opinions
to keep the peace
You disappear a little
every time.

5. Never learning anything new
When you stop growing,
you start doubting.
slides.texte_sophia:
5. Never learning anything new
Use a micro-learning app
like the Sophia app:
history, science or art
in 5 minutes a day.
